claude_only.name: Which system is the master of record for this position and what identifier does it assign?
Is the human-facing position code unique globally or only within a business unit or legal entity?
What resolvable IRI, if any, publishes this position as an org:Post in the organization graph?
When a position is split, merged or renumbered, how are prior identifiers preserved and redirected?
Which working or marketing titles may be used publicly and where do they diverge from the official title?
In which languages is the title published and what are the language-tagged alternative labels?
Has the title been checked as gender-neutral before the vacancy is advertised?
What discrete duties and responsibilities has competent authority assigned to this position?
Which duties are essential because the position exists to perform them, and which are marginal?
How much of the position's time or effort does each duty consume?
Which duty statements are drawn from a governed catalogue rather than written free-hand?
Which internal job or class does this position belong to, and is that assignment mandatory?
Which external occupational codes are asserted, under which scheme and version?
On what evidence was the occupational classification determined, and by whom?
What triggers a review of the occupational classification of this position?
Which evaluation criteria produced the level, and were skills, effort, responsibility and working conditions all applied?
Which other positions are treated as the same category of workers or as work of equal value?
Is the evaluation system documented as objective and gender-neutral, and when was it last validated?
Which organizational unit holds this position at a given effective date?
Which legal entity and business unit govern the position for employment and payroll purposes?
Which cost centre bears the position and does it differ from the holding unit?
How is a position moved between units without losing its identity or history?
To which position does this position report, and is the relation defined post-to-post or person-to-person?
Which positions report to this one, and does that make it a supervisory position?
Are there secondary, functional or matrix reporting lines and what do they authorize?
Who acts for this position when it is vacant or its holder is unavailable?
What is the primary work location of the position and which jurisdiction does it place it in?
Is the position remote-eligible, hybrid or site-bound, and who decides?
Does the position require travel, shift work or seasonal presence, and within what bounds?
Which location-driven obligations, such as pay-range disclosure or local labour rules, attach to this seat?
What FTE and headcount does this position authorize, and are they consistent?
Is the position single or pooled, and may more than one holder occupy it at once?
Is the position full-time or part-time, regular or temporary, and for how long?
How is FTE derived when working hours differ from the standard for the jurisdiction?
Is the position vacant, and how is vacancy derived rather than asserted?
Which assignments currently consume the capacity of this position?
What happens when an incoming holder would exceed authorized capacity?
How long has the position been vacant and does that trigger review or lapse?
Is this position budgeted, and for what amount and currency in which fiscal period?
Is the position funded by an existing position, a grant or a new allocation?
Who authorizes budget changes for the seat and what evidence is retained?
What happens to the position when its funding lapses?
What initial pay level or range applies to this position and how was it derived?
Must the pay range be disclosed to applicants before interview, and under which jurisdiction's rule?
To which category of workers is the position allocated for pay-gap reporting?
Which pay-related fields are restricted from general read access and why?
Which functions are essential and on which of the recognized factors does each determination rest?
Was the written description prepared before advertising or interviewing for the position?
What are the consequences if a holder does not perform the function?
Do collective agreement terms or incumbent work experience contradict the stated essential functions?
Which competencies are required versus preferred, and from which catalogue and version?
Which licences, certifications or regulated qualifications must a holder possess before occupancy?
What experience level and prior-role expectations apply, and how are they measured?
How are requirement sets kept aligned when the underlying catalogue is re-versioned?
Which decisions may the holder of this position take, and up to what limit?
Which competent authority conferred each delegation and when does it expire?
Do the delegations lapse, transfer or escalate when the position is vacant?
Does the position have sufficient seniority and resources to exercise its authority?
Which prescribed regulatory responsibilities are allocated to this position?
Is this position the most senior one responsible for the area, and is the allocation gap-free across the firm?
Is the responsibility shared or split with other positions, and on what justification?
Which statement of responsibilities and responsibilities map record this allocation?
What clearance, vetting or background screening level does this position require?
Does occupancy require prior regulatory approval or fitness assessment of the individual?
Which systems, data classifications or facilities does the seat inherently access?
What happens if a holder's clearance or approval lapses while occupying the seat?
What physical, environmental and contextual conditions characterize the work of this position?
Which hazards or exposures require controls or protective equipment for any holder?
How do working conditions enter the job evaluation that levels this position?
Which physical demands are essential functions and which can be restructured?
What is the current hiring status and activity status of the position, and are they independent?
Which transitions are permitted and who may authorize each one?
May a position be frozen or abolished while occupied, and what must happen first?
Can an abolished position be reinstated, or must a new identity be minted?
What did this position look like as of a given effective date?
When was each version recorded, as distinct from when it took business effect?
Is a change a correction of an erroneous record or a genuine change in the work?
How are open-ended versions terminated and what end-date sentinel is used?
Which competent authority assigned the duties to this position?
Who holds classification authority, and is it delegated or reserved centrally?
Which approvals are prerequisites before a proposed position can be approved?
How are classification decisions kept consistent across comparable positions?
Who certified that the position description accurately states the assigned duties, and when?
When was the description last reviewed and what interval or trigger governs review?
Who may appeal the classification of this position, and what is excluded from appeal?
From what date does a corrected classification take effect, and is it retroactive?
What retention period applies to the position record, its descriptions and its decisions, and under which rule?
Which artifacts must be preserved beyond position abolition to support appeals, pay-gap reporting or regulatory maps?
Which fields carry personal data about incumbents and must be excluded from the seat record or minimized?
What is the disposition action at end of retention: destruction, anonymization or transfer to archive?
To which external schemes is this position mapped and at which level of each hierarchy?
Where do schemes disagree about this position, and how is the disagreement recorded?
What evidence supports a claim of conformance to any external scheme?
Which outbound payloads carry this position and which fields does each include?
How does the published advertisement relate to the underlying position and its openings count?
Which fields must be suppressed or generalized before external publication?
How are downstream consumers notified when the position changes materially?
Which metrics are computed over positions and what is the exact denominator of each?
Is a metric counted in FTE, headcount or authorized establishment, and are these reconciled?
Which reporting obligations require aggregation by category of workers rather than by unit?
How are frozen, proposed and unbudgeted positions treated in establishment counts?
For each material assertion, which source system, document or decision is its provenance?
Which validations must pass before a position is publishable or staffable?
How is a disputed or low-confidence attribute flagged rather than silently corrected?
How are conflicting assertions between the master system and downstream copies reconciled?

grok_only.name: What is the authoritative master-system identifier for this Position, and which system issues and guarantees it?
What governed global IRI, if any, identifies this Position, and what UUID or ULID has the adopting Dimension assigned?
Which additional business identifiers (HRIS position number, budget line, FHIR PractitionerRole.identifier, org:identifier notation) apply, and how do their schemes differ?
How are duplicate or merged Position records detected and which identifier remains canonical after a reorganization?
What alternate labels, abbreviations or working titles are in use, and which audiences may use them?
Does the official title include a required supervisory, leader or honorary prefix or suffix, and under what rule was it applied?
Who has authority to change the official title, and is a reclassification required before the change takes effect?
Is the current classification certified, draft, under appeal, or superseded, and who classified it?
Which classification standard, flysheet or job-family standard was applied, and does the Position fall outside that standard’s coverage?
Is the Position classified as supervisory or leader, and which factor or guide produced that determination?
Which occupation codes from which code sets (ISCO-08, O*NET-SOC or other) describe this Position, including code value, label and codebook version?
If the Position is a military job-slot, is it aligned to ISCO Major Group 0 Armed Forces Occupations rather than a civilian group, and is rank still excluded as person status?
What ISCO skill level, if any, is implied by the mapped unit group, and how does it relate to local qualification requirements?
In which organization and organizational unit is this Position established, and are those references to WM-ORG-002 instances?
Is there any permitted exception to the rule that a Position cannot exist outside an organization?
Does holding this Position confer ex officio membership of another body, and which body is that?
Is this Post also treated as an Organization (for example a committee or timeshared post held by a group), and if so how is that dual typing governed?
To which Position or Positions does this Position report, and is each link line, dotted, functional or matrix?
Which subordinate Positions report to this Position, and what span of control results?
Does this Position confer org:headOf or equivalent leadership of the host unit, independently of who occupies it?
When this Position is vacant, do reporting links remain on the Position so that the chart does not collapse onto the last occupant?
What abstract role or function does any holder of this Position fulfil, and from which controlled vocabulary is it taken?
Is this organization using role-only memberships (for example club membership) for some relationships, and is this record still a true Position?
How is this Position’s role mapped to equivalent roles in other organizations for interoperability?
What is the primary purpose of this Position and how does it relate to the host unit’s mission?
What major recurring duties and responsibilities are assigned, with what approximate percentage of time where recorded?
Which competent authority assigned these duties, and when was the assignment last certified as accurate?
Does one generic description cover a number of identical Positions, and if so which Position instances share it?
What decision, spending, hiring, clinical or signing authorities are attached to this Position rather than to a named person?
What education, licences, security eligibility, physical requirements and experience does this Position require of any holder?
Which competencies or skills are required or desired, from which competency framework, without copying the framework?
If a required credential expires, does that terminate occupancy (assignment) only, or does it also freeze the Position’s fill authority?
Is this Position authorized on the establishment, and under which budget, complement or workforce-plan identity?
What full-time-equivalent capacity is authorized for this Position, and may it be job-shared across holders?
Is fill currently frozen, withheld or over-establishment, and by which authority?
When did authorized capacity last change, and what event (budget cycle, reorganization, reduction-in-force) caused it?
Is the Position currently vacant, encumbered, over-encumbered, or reserved, as derived from live assignments rather than a stored person field?
Which assignment records currently occupy this Position, including job-share fractions, and do they exceed authorized FTE?
Is this Position deliberately modelled with no practitioner or person (unnamed role at a location), and what services or locations still apply?
If someone is acting in this Position, is that an assignment overlay only, leaving the Position identity and classification unchanged?
When was this Position created or established, as event time versus the time that fact was observed or ingested?
When was the Position last reclassified or had its duties substantially redesigned, and did identity survive?
If abolished or eliminated, when did that take effect, may historical occupancy still be queried, and is the identifier retired rather than reused?
Which ORG or PROV change events link this Position to predecessor or successor Positions after merger, split or reorg?
What is the official duty station or site of this Position, and is it a primary, registered or additional site?
Is remote, hybrid or multi-site work authorized for the Position itself, independent of an occupant’s personal agreement?
What contact details belong to the Post rather than to a named person, and when should they be unpublished because the post is vacant?
When did the duty station last change as an event, and when was that change observed?
What geographic area, constituency or jurisdiction is this Position related to, and from which area register?
Which qualification or licence requirements of this Position are jurisdiction-specific?
Did elimination of an electoral or administrative area abolish this Position, as in the Popolo Annapolis example?
What salary band, grade range or estimated salary distribution applies to this Position, in which currency, and is it binding or estimated?
Is the Position unpaid, nominal-pay, fee-basis, piece-work or otherwise outside ordinary classified pay, as 5 U.S.C. § 5102(c) enumerates?
Is actual occupant base salary stored only on the assignment or EmployeeRole, not on this Position?
Which statutory or policy regime applies to this Position, and is it excluded from the default classification or pay statute?
Does the current Position record contain personal data because occupancy, contact or named practitioner fields are populated, and what privacy basis applies?
What sensitivity, national-security or position-of-trust designation applies to the slot itself?
Who may read the Position Description versus occupant-identifying fields, and what exceptions exist for public official posts?
Which organization is the owner or joint owner of this Position record, and is it a bilateral record as the registry default implies?
Who certified the current Position Description and who classified it, at what event times?
Is the PD considered adequate for classification, outdated, under desk audit, or under appeal?
When was the current version ingested into the Dimension, as distinct from when the organizational event occurred?
How long is the Position Description and classification file retained after abolishment, and under which schedule?
Are occupant personal data and assignment records deleted or restricted on a different schedule from the Position slot?
Which fields of a public official’s Post are published, and which remain internal HR data?
What emergency, audit, or named-authority exceptions allow read of otherwise restricted Position or occupant fields?
Which interoperability profile is in force for this Position (ORG-Post-first, Popolo-membership-mediated, FHIR-role, local-HR), and where is it documented?
Which external identifiers or sameAs links assert equivalence to org:Post, Popolo Post, FHIR PractitionerRole or a local HRIS row, and are they same, close or related?
Which known conflicts (direct holds versus membership; Post as Organization; PractitionerRole as assignment) are unresolved for this instance?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
